scenes.text: Did you know there is a silent stranger living inside your own mind, meaning you might actually be two completely different people fighting for ultimate control of your body?

Normally, a thick band of nerves connects your left and right hemispheres, letting them talk easily, but when doctors surgically sever this connection, something truly terrifying happens to the patient.
The two sides start acting completely independently, like when a patient’s left hand would carefully button up a shirt, while their right hand would immediately reach over and try to pull it off.

Your silent right brain can actually hold entirely different beliefs and desires than your speaking left brain. Does your silent half secretly disagree with your choices? Tell us in the comments below to share your thoughts.
